test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ally
solution:
The correct answer is: Enemy

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Ally means friends, specifically friendly nations that support and help each other.

 
 
• Example -* Nature is always **allied **with the inland man, supporting him and saving him from enemies.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Enemy means a person who hates and tries to harm one.
 
 
• Example -* They used to be friends but became bitter **enemies**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Ally' and 'Enemy' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Friend means a person who you know well and who you like a lot but who is usually not a member of your family.
 
• Partner means one of two people who do something together or are closely involved in some way.
 
• Associate means a person that you meet and get to know through your work.
